assets.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational.
Asset type: single rehabilitation demonstration photograph, action 128 T-AXU-006, step 02.
Input image 1 is the edit target. It is the starting neutral seated pose; preserve its woman, clothing, hair, facial identity, chair, floor, background, side camera facing right and full-body framing.
Make a clear but gentle thoracic extension around the TOP EDGE of the chair back. In the starting image the torso and neck are essentially vertical. For this step move the ribcage, shoulders and head as a unit slightly BACKWARD (towards image LEFT), approximately 10 degrees, centered at the upper edge of the chair back at the lower shoulder blade level. The upper back remains visibly resting against that chair edge. Show the sternum lifted and the upper torso leaning mildly backward above the edge, enough that the shoulder position is plainly different from the starting image. The shoulder must shift roughly 4 to 6 cm toward image LEFT. Keep her chin softly tucked with no additional neck extension; let the head follow the upper trunk so it cannot look like only tilting her head.
Keep both hands lightly crossed against her chest following the torso. Keep buttocks and pelvis at the original rear seat position, both thighs and knees, lower legs and shoe soles exactly unmoved and grounded, all chair geometry unmoved. Lower back should remain long and close to neutral; movement comes from middle-upper thoracic spine, not a large hinge at the waist. Keep all the original full-body composition and scale.
Photorealistic studio instructional image. Single woman, single pose, no text, no arrows, no watermark.
Avoid: identical neutral torso, merely tipping head upward, deep lumbar bend, head dangling, loss of chair-back contact, sliding hips, lifted feet, changed face, additional fingers, changed outfit, changed camera.

checks: 相比 s01 肩、胸、头向后小幅移动，上背展开可见。
椅背上缘接触中上背，支撑接触保留。
双手仍交叉胸前跟随躯干。
臀部、双脚与椅子位置和同组 s01 基本保持，双鞋全掌着地。
头随上胸移动，未悬垂，颈部处于舒适位置。
未见腰部大幅折弯或臀部前滑。
人物、白衣深裤白鞋、侧面机位、灰背景、椅子与尺度一致。
visual_acceptance.limitations: AI 编辑在面部与手臂轮廓存在细微像素变化；动作幅度为舒适小幅，不是精确测角影像。
